title: SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one subscription
key_facts: The company TechCrunch calls SpaceX Super Intelligence (SpaceXSI) is bundling its subscriptions, including X Premium, Grok and Cursor, into one plan called "The X Subscription" (TechCrunch).

The plan gives access to Grok for chat, with voice, images, video and the API, Grok's agentic bot, Cursor for AI coding, and X Premium features such as the blue verified checkmark, creator tools and fewer ads.
There are five plans: free, Plus ($8 a month), Premium ($30), Super ($100) and Ultra ($200), with AI usage caps rising by tier.
The free plan offers only limited chat and agent use; Premium or higher is needed for the latest Grok models.
The company said the comparable plan costs the same or less for existing X Premium+ subscribers.
Existing users can switch from their X subscription settings or keep their current plan; the upgrade option rolls out gradually.
TechCrunch says the bundle aims to attract more subscribers in a competitive market with rivals such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
